Help & Training
Quick reference for the monthly Waste Accrual process and the app.
1 · Monthly Review

Select the accrual month, then upload the NetSuite Waste Report, Waste Management Spend, and Completed Installs reports. Each month keeps its own files in this browser.

Amount Billed is current vendor expense. PM Reversal is the prior-month accrual reversal. Pre-Accrual Total is Amount Billed + PM Reversal. CPI Before uses that pre-accrual total.

For WM workrooms, WM Difference = WM Total − Pre-Accrual Total. It is a review signal, not automatically the accrual amount.

2 · Make the Accrual Decision

Use Review Signals, CPI, historical averages, prior accruals, billing timing, invoices, haul activity, and location-specific notes as supporting evidence.

Enter the Final Accrual directly on Monthly Review and press Enter. A blank amount means $0. CPI After shows the projected CPI after the accrual.

The app does not force a universal formula. Judgment remains part of the process.

3 · Month-End

After review, open Month-End. Accrual Entries shows only workrooms with an accrual greater than $0. Export the entries and send the Utility Accrual spreadsheet to Accounting.

After Accounting closes the month, upload the Tableau Avg Waste per Install report. Excel is preferred because it preserves decimal CPI values. Complete Post-Close Validation, then finalize the month.

4 · Files & Exports

Download Original returns the exact file that was uploaded for the selected month. Switching months loads that month's file set.

Accrual History provides Export Selected Month and Export Full History. Both exports contain All Workrooms, including WM and Non-WM.

The Full History workbook uses a wide monthly layout modeled after the historical WM Accrual Summary, plus a detail sheet for auditing. It also includes a Legacy Accrual Summary reference sheet for the pre-August 2026 process.

For anything before August 2026, use Legacy Process & History in the sidebar to download the exact original workbook and review the former process/support tabs.

Important Review Rules

WM Method: compare WM spend/service data with booked GL activity. Roughly $1,000+ of difference is a normal review guideline, but judgment still applies.

CPI: a review signal and context — not the accrual amount.

Direct Vendor: normally no accrual unless billing timing or another specific event creates a reason to accrue.

Closed locations: remain in current review for the closure month plus two additional months, then disappear from current review while history remains.

Legacy Process & History
Reference archive for the waste accrual process before the Waste Accrual Manager became the working process in August 2026.
Original WM Accrual Summary Workbook
Exact historical workbook preserved inside the app for lookback and audit purposes.

Use this workbook for reference prior to August 2026. August 2026 forward is maintained through the Waste Accrual Manager and SharePoint history.

The original workbook includes the historical Accrual Summary plus the former supporting tabs: Waste Expenses, NS Support, WM Support, Completed Installs, and WM Workrooms.

This legacy file is intentionally kept separate from Monthly Review so the old process does not interfere with current calculations or workroom setup.

How Legacy History Appears in Exports

Export Full History now includes a separate Legacy Accrual Summary sheet containing a values snapshot of the historical Accrual Summary tab.

The original workbook remains the source to use when old formulas, support tabs, or the prior process itself need to be reviewed.
